reserveReview.reviewer: OpenAI Codex Safety Score V9 stale-audited reserve refresh 2026-08-29
reserveReview.rationale: UHY's independent auditors' reasonable-assurance report, dated August 24, 2026 and performed under NBC TO 3000/ISAE 3000, covers the assertion that the fair value of BRL reserve assets was at least the BRLA in circulation as of July 31, 2026 at 11:59:59 PM UTC. The report records BRL 101,510,433.68 of cash and equivalents and BRL 24,600,000.00 of overnight repurchase agreements, totaling BRL 126,110,433.68 against BRL 116,923,169.82 of BRLA in circulation; its opinion states the assertion is adequately presented. Cash balances are itemized across Stark Bank, Woovi, BTG Pactual, Itaú Unibanco, XP Investimentos, and Banco Inter, while the repos are with XP and collateralized by Brazilian corporate debentures with next-business-day liquidity. The normalized composition is 80.493287% cash and 19.506713% repos; the report does not identify each debenture issuer or establish reserve-account legal safeguards.
